objective: Auditar en modo solo lectura la ruta canonica API para Tablajeria MPRO y Cienfuegos. No consultar TABLAJERIA.sys.*, no modificar permisos, no ejecutar GRANT, no activar Visible en Operaciones, no crear tablas, no crear endpoints, no exponer secretos. EDARSAHUB sigue siendo fuente canonica final; APIs locales son fuentes operativas externas.

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id WHERE t.name = 'Servidores_Conexiones' ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_tablajeria_cavas_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 * FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE nombre LIKE '%TABLAJ%' OR nombre LIKE '%CAVA%' OR nombre LIKE '%MPRO%' OR nombre LIKE '%CIENFUEGOS%' OR nombre LIKE '%ORIGEN%' OR base_datos LIKE '%tablaj%' OR sistema LIKE '%MPRO%' OR sistema LIKE '%SOFT%' ORDER BY id DESC

queries.name: api_query_config_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, t.create_date, t.modify_date FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Consulta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Query%' OR t.name LIKE '%SQL%' OR t.name LIKE '%Filtro%' OR t.name LIKE '%API%' OR t.name LIKE '%Conexion%' ORDER BY s.name, t.name

queries.name: api_query_config_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Consulta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Query%' OR t.name LIKE '%SQL%' OR t.name LIKE '%Filtro%' OR t.name LIKE '%API%' OR t.name LIKE '%Conexion%' ORDER BY s.name, t.name, c.column_id

queries.name: existing_tablajeria_edarsahub_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR o.name LIKE '%tablaj%' OR o.name LIKE '%Transformacion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Produccion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Merma%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rendimiento%' ORDER BY s.name, o.name
